name: The Ghost of Yaoi
source:
Life has been tough for Erik lately, not only because he was disowned by his parents for being gay, but also get cheated on by his boyfriend and broke up. After getting fired for his third part-time job, his lesbian best friend, Minami, invites him to a summer project group along with Misaki and Cordelia. And little do they know the summer project is soon going to turn into a bloody mystery...

[From [url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/the-ghost-of-yaoi]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Erik最近的生活很艰难，不仅因为自己是同性恋而被父母断绝关系，还因为男友出轨而分手。在因第三份兼职工作而被解雇后，他最好的女同性恋朋友南邀请他与美咲和科迪莉亚一起参加一个夏季项目组。他们几乎不知道夏季项目很快就会变成一个血腥的谜团……

[来自[url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/the-ghost-of-yaoi]Itch.io[/url]]
